summary: Ratio::recip previously swapped numerator and denominator unchecked, returning 1/0 for zero and a negative denominator for negative inputs. The fix panics on a zero numerator and negates both swapped components for negative numerators. The newly added test::test_recip_fail in the num-rational crate checks the zero-input panic. This plan reverses only the implementation; no tests were run.
expected_failure: test did not panic as expected
